name: Barberton Mini 3 2024
information:
This competition is taking place on a **Monday** night!

Given the nature of the competition everyone **WILL** be expected to help out with judging, running, and scrambling. If you have any questions please ask before registering. 

Due to the size of the meeting room **PLEASE** limit the number of guests to 1 if possible.

If time permits, we will add a 4x4 Final. There is a strict policy to leave the venue by 7:30 so we cannot make any promises.
